svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="第 1 页" id="bWiJ8_dwY-L_kP2QI1ST"> <mxGraphModel dx="2196" dy="1186" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant User as \"用户键盘\"
 participant Shell as \"Shell (用户态 Ring3)\"
 participant Ls as \"ls 进程\"
 participant Grep as \"grep 进程\"
 participant Kernel as \"内核 (Ring0)\"
 participant Sched as \"调度器\"
 participant FS as \"文件系统/磁盘\"

 User->>Kernel: \"键盘硬件中断 (Ring0)\"
 Kernel->>Shell: \"tty_read() 返回输入 (iret 到 Ring3)\"

 Shell->>Kernel: \"pipe() [sys_pipe, Ring3→Ring0]\"
 Kernel-->>Shell: \"返回 fds[0], fds[1]\"

 Shell->>Kernel: \"fork() [ls, sys_fork]\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"copy_process: 分配 task_struct<br/>copy_page_tables: 共享物理页, 清 W 位 (COW)\"
 Kernel-->>Shell: \"ls PID (eax=子PID)\"

 Shell->>Kernel: \"fork() [grep, sys_fork]\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"同上 copy_process + COW\"
 Kernel-->>Shell: \"grep PID\"

 Shell->>Kernel: \"父进程 close(pipefd[0]), close(pipefd[1])\"

 Note over Ls: \"ls 子进程 (TASK_RUNNING)\"
 Ls->>Kernel: \"dup2(pipefd[1], 1) [sys_dup2]\"
 Ls->>Kernel: \"execve(\\"/bin/ls\\") [sys_execve]\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"do_execve: flush_old_exec<br/>do_mmap 建立虚拟映射 (Present=0)\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"代码缺页 → do_no_page → read_page\"
 Kernel->>FS: \"bread() → ll_rw_block() 读磁盘\"
 FS-->>Kernel: \"DMA 完成, 硬盘中断唤醒\"
 Kernel->>Ls: \"代码就绪, iret 开始执行\"

 Note over Grep: \"grep 子进程 (TASK_RUNNING)\"
 Grep->>Kernel: \"open(\\"output.txt\\", O_CREAT|O_TRUNC) [sys_open]\"
 Kernel->>FS: \"namei 解析, new_inode/alloc_block 分配 inode 和数据块\"
 Kernel-->>Grep: \"fd=3\"
 Grep->>Kernel: \"dup2(pipefd[0], 0) → dup2(3, 1) → close(3)\"
 Grep->>Kernel: \"execve(\\"/bin/grep\\") [sys_execve]\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"类似 ls 的缺页加载过程\"

 Ls->>Kernel: \"open(\\".\\") [sys_open]\"
 Kernel->>FS: \"namei 解析当前目录\"
 loop \"遍历目录项\"
 Ls->>Kernel: \"getdents() → minix_dir_read()\"
 Kernel->>FS: \"bread() 读取目录数据块\"
 FS-->>Kernel: \"返回目录项 (inode号, 文件名)\"
 Ls->>Kernel: \"stat(filename) [sys_stat]\"
 Kernel->>FS: \"namei 获取 inode, 填充 stat 结构\"
 end

 Ls->>Kernel: \"write(pipefd[1]) → pipe_write()\"
 activate Kernel
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"数据复制到环形缓冲区<br/>更新 PIPE_HEAD\"
 Kernel->>Sched: \"若管道满: TASK_INTERRUPTIBLE → schedule()\"
 Kernel->>Grep: \"唤醒因管道空而睡眠的 grep\"
 deactivate Kernel

 Grep->>Kernel: \"read(pipefd[0]) → pipe_read()\"
 activate Kernel
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"从环形缓冲区复制数据<br/>更新 PIPE_TAIL\"
 Kernel->>Sched: \"若管道空: TASK_INTERRUPTIBLE → schedule()\"
 Kernel->>Ls: \"唤醒因管道满而睡眠的 ls\"
 deactivate Kernel

 Note over Grep: \"regcomp(\\"^d\\") 编译正则\"
 loop \"逐行处理\"
 Grep->>Grep: \"fgets() 读取一行\"
 Grep->>Grep: \"regexec() 匹配 '^d'\"
 alt \"匹配成功\"
 Grep->>Kernel: \"write(1) → file_write()\"
 Kernel->>FS: \"ll_rw_block(WRITE) 写脏缓冲\"
 FS-->>Kernel: \"写盘完成中断\"
 end
 end

 Ls->>Kernel: \"exit() [sys_exit]\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"do_exit: free_page_tables, 关闭文件<br/>状态=TASK_ZOMBIE\"
 Kernel->>Shell: \"发送 SIGCHLD\"
 Kernel->>Sched: \"schedule() 切换\"

 Grep->>Kernel: \"exit() [sys_exit]\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"do_exit: 同上清理\"
 Kernel->>Shell: \"发送 SIGCHLD\"

 Shell->>Kernel: \"waitpid() [sys_waitpid]\"
 Kernel->>Kernel: \"查找 ZOMBIE 子进程<br/>free_page 释放 task_struct 和内核栈\"
 Kernel-->>Shell: \"返回子进程 PID 及退出状态\"

 Shell->>Shell: \"输出下一命令提示符\"",
 "config": null
